canonicalFlows.label: Fattura passiva: competenza e regolamento finanziario separati

steps.action: Preserva bytes, fonte e sha256; deduplica il documento senza perdere le fonti multiple
Risolvi l’identità legale soltanto da CF/PIVA verificato
Consuma l’identità risolta, valida XML/totali e crea una sola fattura passiva con righe e fornitore
Deriva componenti IVA dall’evento fattura validata senza duplicare il totale documentato
Proietta la scrittura documento per competenza, costo e IVA dalla fattura validata senza attendere il pagamento
Osserva descrizione, codice, EAN e confezione; crea candidato alias. Risolve il prodotto soltanto per EAN verificato o mapping confermato
steps.boundary: invoice_supplier_line is read-only provenance; mapping never mutates or revalidates the invoice; no stock, lots, recipes or production

steps.action: Crea o rettifica il debito dalla fattura validata; una nota di credito genera una versione compensativa
Calcola la partita aperta dal debito e dalle sole allocazioni attive
Importa il movimento reale e conserva la prova finanziaria separata
Propone il legame fra movimento e debito; conferma soltanto con chiavi compatibili, centesimi quadrati e causa univoca
Proietta la scrittura definitiva soltanto dalla riconciliazione confermata e idempotente
Proietta la distinta scrittura di regolamento dalla Prima Nota del pagamento confermato; non ricrea costo o IVA
Controlla completezza, unicità, riferimenti, quadrature, tempi, provenienza e freshness senza riscrivere fonti

canonicalFlows.label: F24 a debito: modello, quietanza, banca e scrittura di regolamento
gates: Receipt proves telematic outcome; bank movement proves financial payment.
Definitive financial ledger requires both compatible evidence and exact cents.
A tax-code registry change versions only tax_code_version; it cannot create, modify or revalidate an F24 model, line or receipt.
canonicalFlows.corrections: Credit offsets and later corrections produce explicit compensating/superseding records and invalidate downstream projections; a tax-code correction appends a new validity-bounded tax_code_version and never rewrites F24 document facts.

canonicalFlows.label: F24 a saldo zero: compensazione fiscale senza movimento bancario
gates: When exact net balance is zero, no bank movement is expected.
Credits extinguish debits only through explicit exact-cent offsets.
Fiscal/accounting effects never masquerade as financial ledger movement.
canonicalFlows.corrections: Corrected model or receipt supersedes derived offsets, adjusts only residual obligations and invalidates fiscal/accounting projections.

canonicalFlows.label: Cedolini: competenza, pagamenti e attese fiscali F24
gates: Advances and balance are N:M allocations and cannot duplicate movement cents.
Bank/cash evidence is required for definitive payment.
Tax expectation reconciles by period, section, code and cents.
canonicalFlows.corrections: Replacement payroll recalculates components, TFR and F24 expectations, supersedes affected allocations and invalidates downstream views without deleting paid history.

canonicalFlows.label: Corrispettivi, POS, payout e accredito bancario
gates: Fiscal total, VAT, POS closure, provider payout and bank credit stay distinct.
Manual day data is explicitly provisional and the official XML is the single fiscal writer.
Allocation requires provider references and exact components.
canonicalFlows.corrections: Official XML supersedes provisional manual data, then invalidates/rebuilds VAT and ledger views; corrected payout supersedes derived allocations.

canonicalFlows.label: Riscossione: atti, piano, PagoPA e prova bancaria senza duplicare importi
gates: A plan may cover multiple acts; allocation links explanatory shares but never multiplies the single monetary installment allocation.
A settlement/definition communication is not proof of payment.
PagoPA receipt and bank movement remain distinct evidence and payment needs reconciliation/allocation.
canonicalFlows.corrections: New snapshots and amended plans are versioned; allocations are superseded with audit and projections invalidated.

canonicalFlows.label: Verbali: veicolo, conducente, pagamento e recupero in cedolino
gates: Company payment and employee recovery are separate economic events.
Driver resolves only from unique assignment valid at event time.
Payroll recovery needs explicit authorization and payroll evidence.
Rental invoice/contract links prevent double recognition of the same fine cost.
canonicalFlows.corrections: Assignment or authorization correction creates a superseding record and invalidates driver/recovery projections.

canonicalFlows.label: Storno end-to-end con riapertura delle partite e ricostruzione delle viste
gates: Inactivate affected allocations with audit and reopen residual obligation/open item.
Invalidate and idempotently rebuild accounting and paid-state views through the outbox.
canonicalFlows.corrections: This is the canonical correction path itself; retries reuse the same correction/outbox idempotency keys.
